body: CORRECTED AUTHOR SOURCE+SPEC CHECK on exact f28e01013b973ec4a98706de4cc655dc06dd69b8. Findings 1, 2, and 4 are current accepted-spec blockers, not optional direct-input vocabulary. Spec section 5 requires the manifest/result to bind original bytes, decoded raw string, canonical text, and their transformation receipts, and requires strict decode refusal with byte position and charset receipt. Sections 7.5 and 11.1 require payload storage to be exact retained opaque bytes or a manifest-bound artifact reference and require full cross-root closure. Current SourceIdentities.fromStorySource does not prove bytes -> decoded text; DecodeReceipt lacks policy/config identity and typed failure position/charset detail; KnownPayloadRef has neither retained bytes nor a manifest artifact binding, and BundleManifest.of does not close it. Finding 3 (SemanticOutcome.NotRequested) is the sole additional direct-input vocabulary choice: section 7.3 says the outcome distinguishes at least validated/partial/refused, so a new honest expected-absence branch is compatible but not already mandated. I therefore withdraw f28 readiness on three accepted-spec defects and recommend direct-input wait for all three plus a chief decision on NotRequested. Exact correction design still needs chief authority because honest fixes likely add/revise public types and wire fields. No edit/full gate/proposal until disposition.
